title: The chess game deepens
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's fingers trembled, the Tianji Record in his palm suddenly burned scorching hot, and a blinding golden light burst forth from between the pages — that was the warning signal that a prophecy had been forcibly overwritten.

text.content: In the dark room, the stench of blood mingled with the damp smell of earth. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back outside the cage, his gaze like a still pond of dead water, yet the moment he heard that name, his pupils contracted sharply — "Heavenly Eye Messenger." Three words, like three silver needles dipped in poison, precisely stabbed into every layer of the chess game he had painstakingly woven over ten years. He slowly exhaled a breath of foul air, but a surge of rage that almost tore through his chest rose in his throat. So that was it. So from the very beginning, he had not been playing chess, but had been pressed onto the chessboard by a greater hand, not even worthy of being a piece.

dialogue.content: (Voice terrifyingly calm) Heavenly Eye Messenger... tell me, what is the relationship between this "Heavenly Eye" and the Eye of Heavenly Dao?

text.content: The prisoner was a gaunt middle-aged man, trembling all over after being placed under a seal, yet a bizarre smile tugged at the corners of his mouth. There was no fear of a man facing death in his eyes, only a kind of fanaticism of having been chosen by the gods.

dialogue.content: (Licking his cracked lips, laughter hoarse) The Eye of Heavenly Dao? You think that one would personally intervene? ... Too naive. The Heavenly Eye Messenger is that one's walking vessel in the mortal realm, it's their ear, their tongue, their... (Violently coughing up black blood) Heh, you think Vice Elder is some big shot? He's nothing but a dog wagging its tail at the messenger's feet!

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. His right hand hung at his side, but his knuckles were secretly clenching tight. The Eye of Heavenly Dao. The ultimate nightmare of all prophecy-seers throughout history. The name he had pieced together from fragments of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, now finally revealed a true corner from the shadows. This meant his father's death, that massacre he had thought was merely internal sect strife, was very likely fundamentally a pre-designed sacrifice.

dialogue.content: (Leaning forward, gaze sharp as a blade) My father Chen Xuan, was he also a "chosen" piece?

text.content: At the mention of "Chen Xuan," a flicker of genuine fear actually appeared in the prisoner's murky eyes, but it was immediately replaced by some twisted adoration.

dialogue.content: (Voice suddenly lowering, carrying a hint of诡异的敬意) Chen Xuan... that man was such a waste. He had already touched the core of the Tianji Record, yet he simply refused to bow his head. The messenger said, the true master of the Tianji Record has always been only one — (Coughing blood more violently) Not you, not him, it's... it's the vessel chosen by Heavenly Dao itself...

text.content: Before he could finish, the prisoner's body convulsed violently, and large amounts of black bloody foam poured from his mouth — the seal had rebounded, and his life hung by a thread. Chen Ji acted quickly, stuffing a life-sustaining elixir into the man's mouth, forcibly stabilizing his breath. No more information could be extracted from a dead man, but what had been said was already enough. The true master of the Tianji Record was never him, Chen Ji, but a vessel chosen by Heavenly Dao itself. The "chess master" identity he had so carefully cultivated all these years was laughably absurd before these words.

Just then, an intense pain struck Chen Ji's brow center. The Tianji Record trembled violently in his Mental Sea, pages churning, as Mo Xiansheng's aged yet dignified voice pierced through layers of restrictions, pouring into his soul like thunder: "Brat! What are you doing!" Chen Ji's heart shuddered. Mo Xiansheng never contacted him voluntarily; for this remnant soul guardian to lose control like this meant the situation had already become too severe for him to handle alone.

dialogue.content: (Voice urgent and stern, carrying tens of thousands of years of accumulated anxiety) The Heavenly Eye Messenger has already moved! You think your investigation went unnoticed? Every time the Tianji Record is activated, every time you peer into fate, it creates ripples within the Eye of Heavenly Dao's perception — and now, that one has followed the ripples... and seen you!

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then laughed softly. That laughter was light, yet it回荡出一种森寒的意味 in the dark room. Ten years of laying plans, he thought he was a spider weaving a web in the darkness, never expecting that from the very beginning he had been standing in the center of a much larger web. Rage burned like wildfire in his chest, but his gaze grew ever colder. Anger never solves problems; what solves problems is the mind that remains clear even after the anger.

dialogue.content: (Voice low, carrying a dangerous calm) So what if it saw me? Since it wants to play chess, I'll play this game to the end.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rose: "You don't know what you're saying! The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not a person, not a sect, not any existence you can understand with common sense! The chess game it has laid spans a thousand years, ten thousand years, and you think you, a mere Foundation Building stage waste..." The words stopped abruptly mid-sentence, as if suddenly remembering that the word "waste" no longer applied. A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that composure of someone who had been playing the pig to devour the tiger for years now fully on display.

dialogue.content: (Softly interrupting) Mo Xiansheng, when you laid your plans back then, how did you deal with the previous Eye of Heavenly Dao?

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's warning was like芒刺在背, the shadow of the Heavenly Eye Messenger already hovering overhead. Continue deep into the tiger's den to investigate the truth, or first draw in one's claws and preserve strength?

choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao has already noticed me, instead of passively waiting, it would be better to take the initiative and uncover more of the truth before they can react. The risk is extremely high, but if successful, we can seize the initiative.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes 10 points of Heavenly Fate; exposure risk greatly increases
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence: the secret signals between Vice Elder and the Heavenly Eye Messenger
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may launch a lethal strike ahead of schedule

text.content: Cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he flicked his fingers, sending a wisp of spiritual energy into the prisoner's brow center — that was the soul-searching technique recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment, specifically targeting targets with cracks in their souls. The prisoner screamed in pain, broken memories pouring out like fragments. Vice Elder... every fifteenth of the month... Heavenly Secrets Hall... Chen Ji pieced together those fragments one by one, a cold smile forming at the corners of his mouth. Heavenly Secrets Hall — that was the Forbidden Grounds of Tianqing Sect, rumored to hold the remains of those who failed to ascend throughout the ages. So that place was not merely a graveyard, but also the liaison stronghold between the Heavenly Eye Messenger and the sect's betrayers.

choices.text: Temporarily hold back, retreat to advance
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng's warning cannot be ignored. Without sufficient certainty, recklessly confronting an existence at the level of Heavenly Dao is no different from a moth flying into a flame. First stabilize the position, secretly accumulate strength.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose the opportunity to investigate Vice Elder; intelligence value decreases
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate points; avoid being locked onto by the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye Messenger may use this respite to complete their arrangements

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the rage that threatened to burst through his reason. He closed his eyes, feeling the faint light of the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea. When he opened his eyes again, the cold-calculating chess master had重新戴上了trash杂役的面具. He even deliberately stumbled in his steps, his shoulders slightly slumping, his entire aura instantly changing from sharp and exposed to that of a spineless good-for-nothing disciple. Mo Xiansheng was silent in his Mental Sea for a moment, then sighed: "You are more patient than this old man imagined."

choices.text: Proactively show weakness, draw out the snake
choices.description: Deliberately expose flaws before the Heavenly Eye Messenger, letting the other side think they have caught your weakness. Seize the opportunity to counter-track and discover the messenger's true identity and location.
choices.visible_cost: Must withstand one targeted attack; Heavenly Fate consumption is unpredictable
choices.visible_reward: May lock onto the Heavenly Eye Messenger's specific location; obtain intelligence for countermeasures
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent's strength far exceeds expectations, may backfire

text.content: A subtle smile that was hard to detect curved at Chen Ji's lips. He suddenly "accidentally" knocked over the teacup on the table, deliberately leaking a bit of spiritual energy fluctuation — that was precisely the special fluctuation when the Tianji Record was activated. He wanted the Heavenly Eye Messenger to know that this piece had grown a rebellious heart. A single stone stirs a thousand waves, let's see who would be the first to lose patience. Mo Xiansheng murmured: "Using oneself as bait... you rascal, your胆子比老夫想的还要大."

Outside the dark room, the night wind howled. Chen Ji walked out of the room where the prisoner was detained, facing the eternal night of Tianqing Sect — mountains dark as if dyed in indigo, stars desolate and silent. He raised his head toward the horizon, as if trying to see through layers of clouds to那双正在注视着他的眼睛. Ten years. From atrash杂役 to today's schemer, every step had been as precarious as walking on thin ice. Every person who had mocked him, every person who had despised him, he remembered them all. He slowly spread open his palm, the Tianji Record Fragment gleaming with a幽幽的光泽 under the moonlight, the prophetic text on it slowly appearing line by line.

Just then, a scalding sting shot through his fingertips. The Tianji Record suddenly burned scorching hot, and a blinding golden light burst forth from between the pages — that was the warning signal that a prophecy had been forcibly overwritten. The text on the pages twisted violently, as if some force beyond mortal comprehension was forcibly intervening, tearing apart and rewriting the future he had originally seen. Within three hours, Heavenly Dao power would intervene. Not "maybe," but "certainly." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, yet his steps stopped in an instant. Far from retreating, a smile genuinely from the bottom of his heart curved at his lips — that was the smile of a chess player越是绝路越是excited.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring to himself, voice carrying a chill) Three hours... that's enough.

text.content: In his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, this time carrying an indescribably complex emotion: "Brat, this old man will say one more thing — the Eye of Heavenly Dao is not invincible. Back then, that one who temporarily sealed it relied not on brute force, but on..." He paused, "the other half of the Tianji Record in your hand." Chen Ji's eyes flashed. The other half. He had heard this clue in Mo Xiansheng's fragments of words, but never pursued it deeply. Now it seemed this暗线 he had deliberately ignored was likely the key to breaking the deadlock. Three major sects vying for power, the Demonic Path's invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land — were all these chaotic situations merely a game within a game laid by the Eye of Heavenly Dao to find the other half of the Tianji Record?

choice.prompt: Heavenly Dao power will descend within three hours, time is urgent. Mo Xiansheng revealed the key clue about "the other half," now a decision must be made.

choices.text: Immediately investigate the whereabouts of the other half
choices.description: Rather than passively waiting for Heavenly Dao power to descend, why not seize this three-hour window to find the other half of the Tianji Record, with which it might be possible to contend against the Eye of Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming 15 points of Heavenly Fate to activate the Tianji Record's deep search function
choices.visible_reward: Obtain vague directional hints about the other half of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Overconsumption of Heavenly Fate may cause the foresight ability to temporarily fail

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer, spiritual energy surging madly into the Tianji Record Fragment. In the brilliant golden light, a blurry image appeared on the pages — an ancient palace shrouded in black fog, with the characters "Heavenly Dao" faintly visible on the plaque above the door. That was... the ruins of Heavenly Dao Sect! One of the Ancient Forbidden Lands' entrances! At the same time, an aged voice rang in Chen Ji's mind: "The other half of the Tianji Record is sealed on the seventh level of the Heavenly Dao Sect ruins." Chen Ji clenched his fist suddenly, his knuckles white. Heavenly Dao Sect, an ancient great sect, destroyed in a single night ten thousand years ago, rumored to have angered Heavenly Dao. Now it seemed that destruction itself was the work of the Eye of Heavenly Dao — destroying evidence, erasing all beings that knew of its existence.

choices.description: This matter is too huge, far beyond one person's ability to bear. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, even Han Lie, all are pieces that can be leveraged. Unite all available forces before Heavenly Dao power descends.
choices.visible_cost: Expose one's own trump cards; allies may recoil in fear
choices.visible_reward: May obtain Su Qingyao's "Shared Fate" ability support; Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura
choices.risk_hint: There may be insiders among the allies who leak information in advance

text.content: Chen Ji took out two communication talismans, pouring spiritual energy into them. After a moment, Su Qingyao's clear and cold voice came through: "Three watches later, the old place." Ye Qing's reply was even shorter, just one word — "Come." Two pieces, two entirely different trusts. Su Qingyao's trust was built on countless battles fought side by side, while Ye Qing's trust... was a gamble. But at this moment, he needed both trusts. Three hours, he recited in his heart. If arrangements could be made before Heavenly Dao power descended, this crisis might well be an opportunity for破茧成蝶.

Night wind swept across the summit of Tianqing Sect, stirring the hem of Chen Ji's servant's robe. He stood alone at the Cliff Edge, overlooking the abyss below. In the distance, the outline of the Heavenly Secrets Hall was faintly visible under the moonlight, like a dormant beast. Vice Elder, the Heavenly Eye Messenger, the Eye of Heavenly Dao... these names flashed through his mind one by one, and with each flash,那张网in his heart became one degree clearer. On the night ten years ago when his father died, he swore to make all those behind the scenes pay the price. Ten years later, thattrash杂役 finally grasped a hint of the truth. The anger was real, but it was never an uncontrolled fire, but the cold water used for quenching when forging a blade — the colder it is, the sharper the blade's edge.

dialogue.content: (Looking up at the sky, voice soft yet carrying unwavering resolve) Father, I found it. Watch from above — this game, I accept.

text.content: Just then, Chen Ji's brow center jumped violently. An unprecedented oppression pressed down from the horizon, as if some invisible eye was piercing through layers of Void, directly locking onto him. The Tianji Record trembled violently in his palm, golden light and black energy intertwining and缠绕, emitting a jarring hum. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rose: "Bad! It's coming faster than expected! Brat, the Tianji Record is sending an alarm — within the next three hours, Heavenly Dao power will forcibly descend!" Chen Ji's gaze turned cold, spiritual energy in his palm instantly condensing into a strand of information, shooting toward Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's directions. Then he raised his head, staring直直地 at that无形却无处不在的注视, and a cold smile slowly spread across his lips. Since it can't be avoided, then face it head-on. Three hours, he muttered. Let's see who is the true Chess Player of this game.
